consistent_location_note: Pagination remains in a predictable relative location across the paginated set when it is in use.
current_page_semantics_note: Exactly one item in the pagination set is marked as the current page and that meaning does not depend on color alone.
delivery_role_note: Bounded page-to-page continuity surface for official voter-information routes that split answer-bearing result sets across numbered pages.
end_of_set_and_no_results_note: The route distinguishes no-results, end-of-set, and additional-pages-exist states rather than letting page 1 silently stand in for all outcomes.
help_or_overview_escape_note: Where pagination alone may not resolve the case, a visible overview/help lane remains available instead of leaving the voter to brute-force the result set.
mobile_compaction_note: Compact/mobile variants were reviewed so ellipsis or reduced-number displays do not erase the fact that more official results exist.
more_pages_visibility_note: The route records how it signals that more pages exist or that the visible page is the end of the set.
page_link_purpose_note: Pagination links, previous/next controls, and first/last controls keep their purpose explicit enough that ordinary users can predict where they go.
page_size_or_boundary_shift_note: The office reviewed whether page-size, sort, or filter controls materially change page boundaries for answer-bearing results.

paginated_routes.current_page_indicator_note: The current page is identified both visually and with aria-current=page so assistive technologies announce the current result-set position.
paginated_routes.mobile_compaction_note: Compact/mobile pagination still leaves continuation cues understandable when not all page numbers are shown.
paginated_routes.more_pages_visibility_note: The route makes clear that additional pages exist beyond page 1 and does not make the first page look like the complete official set.
paginated_routes.page_link_purpose_note: Numbered page links and previous/next controls make clear that they continue the same result set rather than switching topic or workflow.
paginated_routes.page_size_or_boundary_shift_note: If the route allows changing results per page, the office reviews whether the decisive location moves to a different page and whether that shift remains legible.
